english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for returning to normal health, as in a full recovery.
This is the all-purpose noun for the gradual restoration of health.
Use this for recovery to health after an illness, rather than for the treatment that causes it.

examples.english: I made a pretty good recovery after my surgery.
examples.traditional: 我做完手術之後，康復得幾好。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6 hong1 fuk6 dak1 gei2 hou2

examples.english: After the operation, recuperation takes time, so you can't rush it.
examples.traditional: 手術之後要慢慢康復，唔可以心急。
examples.jyutping: sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6 jiu3 maan6 maan2 hong1 fuk6 m4 ho2 ji5 sam1 gap1

examples.english: Their cure took only three months after surgery.
examples.traditional: 佢做完手術，三個月就康復喇。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jyun4 sau2 seot6 saam1 go3 jyut6 zau6 hong1 fuk6 laa3
